Now I need to determine the molecular formula. Let me analyze the isotope pattern:
- The second peak (M+1) is at 11.4% relative intensity

- 11.4% / 1.1% ≈ 10 carbons

- 10 C = 120 Da
- Remaining mass = 178 - 120 = 58 Da

This could be:
- C10H10O2 = 120 + 10 + 32 = 162 Da (too light)

Let me verify: C10H10O3 = 10(12) + 10(1) + 3(16) = 120 + 10 + 48 = 178 Da

The exact mass of C10H10O3 = 10(12.000) + 10(1.00783) + 3(15.9994) = 120.000 + 10.0783 + 47.9982 = 178.0765 Da

The observed m/z of 179.09463 would be [M+H]+ = 178.0765 + 1.0078 = 179.0843 Da

This is very close to the observed value (179.09463), with a small difference that could be due to measurement precision or calibration.

The molecular formula is C10H10O3.
